responsibility: This machine description file provides the DFA scheduler model for the MIPS R10000 family tuning point used by GCC, including the related R12K/R14K/R16K derivatives until separate tuning is added. It defines the R10K issue queues, ALU, load/store, floating-point add/multiply/divide/sqrt resources, instruction reservations, and bypasses for integer, memory, coprocessor-transfer, multiply/divide, fused-multiply-add, and FP divide/square-root operations, so that the instruction scheduler in the MIPS backend can estimate latency, issue restrictions, and parallelism for code tuned to r10000.
